title: First Mid Wealth Management Welcomes Financial Advisor Kyle Wagenbach
summary: Burlington, IA (May 11, 2026) First Mid Wealth Management, a division of First Mid Bancshares, Inc. and a branch office of Raymond James, announces that Financial Advisor Kyle Wagenbach has joined its team. Wagenbach brings a unique and analytical perspective to financial planning, drawing on a diverse background in engineering, economics, entrepreneurship, and agriculture. He specializes in long-term investment strategies and risk management, developing customized solutions tailored to each clients unique objectives. We are thrilled to welcome Kyle to our team, said Eric Benne, SVP, Director of Trust at First Mid Wealth Management. His commitment to client-first service, combined with his diverse background, strengthens our ability to deliver thoughtful, personalized financial strategies.
